about: Shared vectors for the extension quality rubric (swamp-club#3781). Each case is the input to composeScore — what one version and its package say, and for the CLI before publish a predicted repository-verified — and the rows, points and percentage it must produce. A provisional row earns nothing yet, so the percentage divides by every row's points (swamp-club#3845). swamp's quality and push and the registry's scorecard both compose scores with @swamp-club/extension-scoring and run these vectors.
